mapper.sql: l.id, l.user_id as userId, l.name, l.lender_name as lenderName, l.lender_bank_code as lenderBankCode, l.principal_amount as principalAmount, l.outstanding_balance as outstandingBalance, l.interest_rate_pct as interestRatePct, l.monthly_payment as monthlyPayment, l.repayment_method as repaymentMethod, l.maturity_date as maturityDate, l.disbursement_card_id as disbursementCardId, l.repayment_card_id as repaymentCardId, l.status, l.notes, l.sort_order as sortOrder, l.deleted, l.created_by as createdBy, l.created_at as createdAt, l.updated_by as updatedBy, l.updated_at as updatedAt

coalesce(nullif(trim(dc.card_name), ''), concat(coalesce(dc.bank_code, ''), ' ', coalesce(dc.card_type_code, ''))) as disbursementCardLabel, coalesce(nullif(trim(rc.card_name), ''), concat(coalesce(rc.bank_code, ''), ' ', coalesce(rc.card_type_code, ''))) as repaymentCardLabel, (select count(*) from fin_loan_txn_link lk where lk.loan_id = l.id and lk.user_id = l.user_id) as linkCount
mapper.select: select , from fin_loan l left join fin_bank_account dc on dc.id = l.disbursement_card_id and coalesce(dc.deleted, 0) != 1 left join fin_bank_account rc on rc.id = l.repayment_card_id and coalesce(rc.deleted, 0) != 1 where l.user_id = #{userId} and coalesce(l.deleted, 0) = 0 order by coalesce(l.interest_rate_pct, 0) desc, l.sort_order, l.lender_name

select , from fin_loan l left join fin_bank_account dc on dc.id = l.disbursement_card_id and coalesce(dc.deleted, 0) != 1 left join fin_bank_account rc on rc.id = l.repayment_card_id and coalesce(rc.deleted, 0) != 1 where l.id = #{id} and l.user_id = #{userId} and coalesce(l.deleted, 0) = 0
mapper.insert: insert into fin_loan ( id, user_id, name, lender_name, lender_bank_code, principal_amount, outstanding_balance, interest_rate_pct, monthly_payment, repayment_method, maturity_date, disbursement_card_id, repayment_card_id, status, notes, sort_order, deleted, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at ) values ( #{loan.id}, #{userId}, #{loan.name}, #{loan.lenderName}, #{loan.lenderBankCode}, #{loan.principalAmount}, #{loan.outstandingBalance}, #{loan.interestRatePct}, #{loan.monthlyPayment}, #{loan.repaymentMethod}, #{loan.maturityDate}, #{loan.disbursementCardId}, #{loan.repaymentCardId}, #{loan.status}, #{loan.notes}, #{loan.sortOrder}, 0, #{actor}, now(3), #{actor}, now(3) )
mapper.update: update fin_loan set name = #{loan.name}, lender_name = #{loan.lenderName}, lender_bank_code = #{loan.lenderBankCode}, principal_amount = #{loan.principalAmount}, outstanding_balance = #{loan.outstandingBalance}, interest_rate_pct = #{loan.interestRatePct}, monthly_payment = #{loan.monthlyPayment}, repayment_method = #{loan.repaymentMethod}, maturity_date = #{loan.maturityDate}, disbursement_card_id = #{loan.disbursementCardId}, repayment_card_id = #{loan.repaymentCardId}, status = #{loan.status}, notes = #{loan.notes}, sort_order = #{loan.sortOrder}, updated_by = #{actor}, updated_at = now(3) where id = #{loan.id} and user_id = #{loan.userId} and coalesce(deleted, 0) = 0
mapper.select: select l.id, l.loan_id as loanId, l.transaction_id as transactionId, l.link_type as linkType, l.user_id as userId, l.created_by as createdBy, l.created_at as createdAt, t.transaction_date as transactionDate, t.transaction_desc as transactionDesc, t.income_money as incomeMoney, t.expense_amount as expenseAmount, t.bank_card_name as bankCardName from fin_loan_txn_link l left join transaction t on t.id = l.transaction_id and coalesce(t.deleted, 0) != 1 where l.loan_id = #{loanId} and l.user_id = #{userId} order by coalesce(t.transaction_date, l.created_at) desc, l.created_at desc

select id, loan_id as loanId, transaction_id as transactionId, link_type as linkType, user_id as userId, created_by as createdBy, created_at as createdAt from fin_loan_txn_link where loan_id = #{loanId} and transaction_id = #{transactionId} and user_id = #{userId} limit 1

select coalesce(sum(coalesce(l.outstanding_balance, l.principal_amount)), 0) from fin_loan l where l.user_id = #{userId} and coalesce(l.deleted, 0) = 0 and upper(coalesce(l.status, 'ACTIVE')) = 'ACTIVE'
select coalesce(sum(l.monthly_payment), 0) from fin_loan l where l.user_id = #{userId} and coalesce(l.deleted, 0) = 0 and upper(coalesce(l.status, 'ACTIVE')) = 'ACTIVE'

select year(t.transaction_date) as year, fl.id as loanId, fl.lender_name as lenderName, lk.link_type as linkType, sum( case when lk.link_type = 'DISBURSEMENT' then coalesce(t.income_money, 0) when lk.link_type in ('REPAYMENT', 'INTEREST') then coalesce(t.expense_amount, abs(coalesce(t.balance_money, 0))) else 0 end ) as amount from fin_loan_txn_link lk inner join fin_loan fl on fl.id = lk.loan_id and fl.user_id = lk.user_id and coalesce(fl.deleted, 0) = 0 inner join transaction t on t.id = lk.transaction_id and coalesce(t.deleted, 0) != 1 where lk.user_id = #{userId} and t.transaction_date is not null and t.transaction_date >= #{rangeStart} and t.transaction_date < #{rangeEndExclusive} group by year(t.transaction_date), fl.id, fl.lender_name, lk.link_type
